items.title: Offline packages and synchronisation
items.acceptance: A learner can download permitted content, use lessons offline, persist progress locally, restart, reconnect and synchronise without silent loss or duplicate writes.
evidence: scripts/verify-offline-browser.mjs: 25 passed, 0 failed — downloaded Fractions, production service worker, offline reload, browser restart, local-only queue, reconnect, exactly one ledger event, duplicate replay refused, sign-out cleanup
scripts/production-check.mjs: offline sync protocol — dedupe, refusals, paging, replay
items.remainingWork: Re-run after any change to the service worker, offline store or sync protocol. External media remains link-only unless redistribution permission exists.
